customManagers.description: Update the Mermaid version that the community site loads from the jsDelivr CDN

packageRules.description: Put a Mermaid update in its own pull request. A new Mermaid version can change the layout and the labels of every diagram of the site, so a person must look at the diagrams before the merge
prBodyNotes:
> [!WARNING]
> A new Mermaid version can change the layout and the labels of every diagram of the site. Before you merge, build the site and look at the diagrams. `AGENTS.md` has the list of things to check, in the section "Mermaid diagrams".
